issue.title: just symvision red: ~41 unused public symbols from closed beads were masked behind the private-symbol rule

task_type_fields.node_id: just symvision (lint (symvision) stage of just check)
task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
`just symvision` (the `lint (symvision)` stage of `just check`) is deterministic static analysis: same tree, same result. symvision's cli.py returns 1 on the private-symbol rule *before* it evaluates the unused-public rule. A string of private-symbol failures (the `_runs` imports tracked in sase-1h6, then `_list_bead_state_changes_silent` orphaned by 39dc48f03c) hid every unused public symbol for about a day. Each epic's land check saw only the KNOWN private item. The sase-1hf land agent deleted the dead private helper (master 3a4178b15a + landing diff). The unused-public rule then reported 62 symbols. Portions owned by still-active epics were routed as DISCOVERED ISSUE notes on sase-1h7, sase-1h8, sase-1hi, and sase-116.

This task covers the portion whose owners are closed:
- sase-1gu.2 (08c8a56b36): aggregate_rows (instructions/verify.py); check_instructions_delivery, check_instructions_helpers (doctor/checks_instructions.py); claude_projects_root, codex_sessions_root, grok_cwd_dir, grok_sessions_root (instructions/_runs.py); context_block_texts (instructions/muse.py); observe_agy_session (instructions/agy.py); report_to_json_dict (instructions/render.py); run_instructions_verify (main/instructions_handler.py)
- sase-1h3.1-.6: CoreMemoryUnit, MemoryIntroTexts, ReferenceMemoryUnit, WebMemoryUnit (amd/memory_units.py); InstructionManifestError (core/instruction_manifest.py and instructions/manifest.py); cache_entry_path, CacheKeyInputs, prune_cache_entries (instructions/cache.py); default_provider, detect_host (instructions/facts.py); ParityIssue, ParityReport (instructions/parity.py); run_instructions_render (main/instructions_handler.py); instruction_shadow_render_enabled (llm_provider/_instruction_boundary.py; flag retirement sase-1h4); RunManifest (instructions/manifests.py); check_instructions_coverage (doctor/checks_instructions.py); coverage_block_to_json_dict, section_diff_to_json_dict (instructions/render.py)
- sase-1g4 (81eaae59ea): advertised_config_type_names, validate_config_input_type (ace/tui/modals/macro_config_modal.py); macro_input_choice_to_wire (macro/_input_hint_wire.py)
- sase-1h9.2/.3: git_fetch_origin, git_is_ahead_of_upstream, git_remote_tracking_ref (llm_provider/commit_finalizer_git_status.py); controller_failure_for_handoff (finalizers/controller_run.py); finalizer_owned_monitor_refusal (monitor/start_flow.py); finalizer_reports_failure (axe/run_agent_exec_finalize.py)
- 39dc48f03c (no bead): staged_sdd_files (sdd/_commit_store.py)

Repro: `SASE_SYMVISION_BEAD_STATUS_ONLY=1 BD_COMMAND=tools/sase_bead .venv/bin/symvision src/sase --exclude-decorator gate_command_entrypoint --exclude-decorator builtin_chop` (the `_lint-symvision` recipe body) on a tree that contains the sase-1hf landing. Fix each symbol by the symvision memory hierarchy: delete, privatize, pragma, or --epic-symbol. Consider asking upstream symvision to report every rule before exiting so one red rule cannot mask another.

issue.creation_reason: The sase-1hf landing removed the dead private helper that made symvision exit early, exposing a day of accumulated unused public symbols; the closed-owner share has no epic to absorb it.

payload.description: sase-1h6's _runs private-import failure was one of the private-rule errors that masked these unused publics; its four _runs.py root helpers now appear here as unused public
